annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing EU AI Factories and planned AI Gigafactories, EuroHPC-based supercomputing hubs giving startups, SMEs, researchers and industry access to compute for trustworthy AI. Lists 19 factories and 13 antennas, selection rounds from 2024 to 2025, and about €10 billion in public investment. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: 19 AI Factories and 13 Antennas are being set up through the EuroHPC JU, with priority access for startups and SMEs.
At least 9 new AI-optimised supercomputers will be procured, more than tripling EuroHPC AI computing capacity.
A call for tenders seeks up to seven AI Gigafactories with over 100,000 advanced AI processors, backed by up to €10 billion in public funding.
Public and Member State investment in supercomputing and AI Factories is set to reach €10 billion over 2021-2027.
The European AI Office coordinates with EuroHPC JU and the initiative is framed as supporting AI Act-aligned trustworthy AI.
